== Reading the tables

NOTE: Times are local (GMT in winter).

Heights are in metres above chart datum. See <<springs>> and the
https://tides.example.org/saltmere[online tables].

[#springs]
== Spring tides

[source,python]
----
def height(hour):
    return 2.4 + 1.6 * cos(hour / 12.42 * 2 * pi)
----
